dossier_meta.catalog_title: Conjecture on maximum cliques with no $K_t$-immersion
dossier_meta.statement_text: The maximum number of cliques in a graph on $n \geq t-2$ vertices with no $K_t$-immersion is $2^{t-2}(n-t+3)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors construct a graph on $n$ vertices with no weak $K_t$-immersion achieving $2^{t-2}(n-t+3)$ cliques: begin with a clique $K$ on $t-2$ vertices and attach $n-t+2$ additional vertices each with neighborhood $K$. Since every vertex outside $K$ has degree $t-2 < t-1$, no $K_t$-immersion exists. The authors conjecture this construction is optimal.
